overrides.name: Freshwater Amazonian varzea cassava rotation
overrides.status: inferred historical analogue; not a measured 1300 rotation
overrides.interpretation: One active cropping year is a conservative scenario assumption; 1.6 years is mean fallow from 59 modern middle-Madeira floodplain fields. Transfer only to named inland varzea ecological units. Do not transfer to uplands, dark earths without a mask, blackwater floodplains, or tidal/coastal units. Short-cycle low-starch cultivar transfer remains uncertain.

Kansai.label: Kansai (rice only)
Kansai.status: Single rice crop equivalent; winter cereal contribution unquantified. Published multi-cropping coefficient 2 is retained separately, not interpreted as two rice harvests. Yield anchor harvested-area convention remains uncertain.
